approval_ref: The active user goal requires continued efficiency and accuracy improvements for RFI, Submittal and Email content under persistent /ponytail constraints.
notes: A synthetic RFI reply currently creates three extraction batches: headers, current body and quoted history.
Existing deterministic publication checks already reject email headers and quoted history as current material or QA sources.
Retain every evidence fragment for review and workflow relationships, but close routing-only fragments locally before model batching.
Reuse existing evidence status and extraction payload fields; add no dependency, queue, model call or database migration.

The synthetic reply reduced extraction batches from three to one while retaining all evidence and the same published material; 600 Python tests and every specification, manifest and JavaScript check passed.
title: Skip routing-only email evidence before model extraction
objective: Retain email headers and quoted history as reviewable evidence while preventing them from consuming extraction requests or creating current material and QA candidates.
